cohort: 3,723 pregnant women with lab-confirmed COVID-19 and 3,744 age-matched controls in India between April and November 2020
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with a higher incidence of antenatal complications, induction of labor, cesarean delivery, and maternal mortality compared to controls.
mod_finding: Induction and cesarean delivery rates were higher among COVID-19 positive women.
